# Session Log Canvas Coupling Map

Read this map when a schema diff, release note, or session check shows a change. Paths are relative to this file. The canvas root is [extensions/hve-core/session-log](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/).

## Where Copilot Describes Its Session Data

Each installed Copilot package (`<COPILOT_HOME or ~/.copilot>/pkg/<platform>/<version>/`) and the package VS Code bundles (`@github/copilot-sdk-<platform>`) carry:

| File                                        | What it tells you                                                  |
|---------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `schemas/session-events.schema.json`        | Every event type, its `data` fields, and whether it is ephemeral   |
| `changelog.json` (CLI package)              | Release notes per version                                          |
| `copilot-sdk/generated/session-events.d.ts` | The same event types as TypeScript                                 |
| `copilot-sdk/generated/rpc.d.ts`            | Session RPC methods, including the canvas open and action requests |
| `copilot-sdk/canvas.d.ts`                   | `createCanvas`, canvas actions, `CanvasError`, and the open result |
| `copilot-sdk/extension.d.ts`                | `joinSession` and the extension entry contract                     |
| `copilot-sdk/docs/extensions.md`            | Extension and canvas authoring guidance                            |

## Surfaces and Dependents

| Surface                       | Recorded as                                                                                                                                                                       | Canvas code                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | Tests                                                                                                                                                                        |
|-------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Storage location              | `<COPILOT_HOME or ~/.copilot>/session-state/<session id>/`                                                                                                                        | [lib/paths.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/lib/paths.mjs)                                                                                                                                                               | [tests/paths.test.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/tests/paths.test.mjs)                                                                                        |
| Session list metadata         | `workspace.yaml` (`name`, `summary`, `cwd`, `repository`, `branch`, `client_name`, `updated_at`) and `inuse.<pid>.lock`                                                           | [lib/sessions.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/lib/sessions.mjs) (`CLIENT_LABELS`), [lib/yaml.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/lib/yaml.mjs)                                                                | [tests/sessions.test.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/tests/sessions.test.mjs)                                                                                  |
| Event envelope                | `events.jsonl` lines with `type`, `data`, `id`, `timestamp`, `parentId`, and `agentId` for subagents                                                                              | [lib/indexer.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/lib/indexer.mjs) (`SessionIndex`, `HANDLED_EVENT_TYPES`)                                                                                                                   | [tests/indexer.test.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/tests/indexer.test.mjs), [tests/fixtures.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/tests/fixtures.mjs) |
| Prompts, responses, and turns | `user.message`, `assistant.message`, `assistant.turn_start`, `assistant.turn_end`, `session.usage_record`                                                                         | Indexer `#apply` and `withBodies`; [ui/render.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/ui/render.mjs) entry kinds                                                                                                                | Indexer and server tests                                                                                                                                                     |
| Tool calls                    | `tool.execution_start`, `tool.execution_complete` (`result.content`, `result.detailedContent`, `error`), `external_tool.*`                                                        | Indexer tool cases and `#toolPreview`                                                                                                                                                                                                 | Indexer tests (previews)                                                                                                                                                     |
| Subagents                     | `subagent.*` events with `agentId`; `subagent.started.data.toolCallId` links the spawning call                                                                                    | Indexer subagent cases and `#linkSubagent`; agent tree in [ui/app.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/ui/app.mjs)                                                                                                           | Indexer tests (nesting)                                                                                                                                                      |
| Hooks                         | `hook.start` and `hook.end` (`hookInvocationId`, `hookType`, `input`, `output`, `error`)                                                                                          | Indexer hook pairing and `PRE_TURN_HOOKS`                                                                                                                                                                                             | Indexer tests (hook runs)                                                                                                                                                    |
| Compaction                    | `session.compaction_start`, `session.compaction_complete`, and the compaction call's `model.messages_snapshot`                                                                    | Indexer compaction cases, `pickCompactionRequest`, `readCompactionText`; `GET /api/compaction` in [lib/server.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/lib/server.mjs)                                                           | Indexer and server compaction tests                                                                                                                                          |
| System prompt                 | `system.message` `content` and `contentBlocks`: tagged sections, `<available_skills>`, the instruction file table, `<agent_instructions>`                                         | Indexer `analyzeSystemPrompt`, `diffSections`, and prompt versions; `GET /api/system-prompt`                                                                                                                                          | Indexer tests (prompt analysis and versions)                                                                                                                                 |
| Model and context             | `session.start`, `session.model_change`, `session.usage_record`, `session.usage_checkpoint` (`promptCacheBreakState`)                                                             | Indexer model, usage, and context tracking; `getRecordedInventory`                                                                                                                                                                    | Indexer and inventory tests                                                                                                                                                  |
| Live inventories              | `session.rpc`: `agent.list`, `agent.getCurrent`, `skills.list`, `skills.getInvoked`, `instructions.getSources`, `mcp.list`, `plugins.list`, `extensions.list`, `model.getCurrent` | [lib/inventory.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/lib/inventory.mjs) (`createLiveInventoryProvider`)                                                                                                                       | [tests/inventory.test.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/tests/inventory.test.mjs)                                                                                |
| Canvas SDK                    | `@github/copilot-sdk/extension`: `joinSession`, `createCanvas`, `CanvasError`, the open request `sessionId`                                                                       | [extension.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/extension.mjs), [lib/lifecycle.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/lib/lifecycle.mjs), [lib/actions.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/lib/actions.mjs) | Lifecycle, actions, and static tests                                                                                                                                         |
